import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    return (params[0]*np.exp(-params[1]*A**2)
            + params[2]*np.sin(params[3]*np.sqrt(A))
            + params[4]*np.sin(params[5]*np.sqrt(t))*np.exp(-params[6]*A**2)
            + params[7]*np.exp(-params[8]*t**2)
            + params[9]*A)
